entries.announcementText: Nana's got the right of way!

telegraph.description: A wide red rectangular lane locks toward the player's position, with expanding chevrons and a filling danger strip showing its exact direction, width, and endpoint.

effect.description: Nana rockets down the locked lane, dealing moderate damage and strong knockback, then stops at the lane endpoint or the first solid wall.

codex.shortDescription: Nana charges through a locked scrap-cart lane.
codex.fullDescription: Nana revs a ramshackle scrap cart before blasting through a clearly marked lane and scattering anything caught in her path.
codex.counterplay: Wait for the lane to lock, then sidestep perpendicular to it before the cart launches.

presentation.vfxDescription: Shaking cart parts, gears, bolts, exhaust, sparks, dust, trailing scrap, screen shake, and an oversized impact burst.

entries.announcementText: Don Paco's painting the whole block!

telegraph.description: A locked 70-degree cone shows five red projectile arrows and five expanding red landing circles, exposing every path and impact zone.

effect.description: Don Paco fires five caustic spit globs. Each impact deals moderate damage and leaves a sticky slowing slick for four seconds.

codex.shortDescription: Don Paco fans caustic spit across a locked cone.
codex.fullDescription: Five telegraphed spit globs land across a broad cone, bursting on impact and leaving temporary slowing slicks.
codex.counterplay: Escape laterally or circle behind Don Paco after the cone locks, then avoid the marked landing circles and slicks.

presentation.vfxDescription: Wobbling cheek bulge, foamy bubbles, neon-green trails, huge wet splashes, acidic steam, drips, and bubbling puddle rims.

telegraph.description: Green-gold concentric pulses contract into Wei while a red aura builds around his planted body, clearly signaling the coming enforcer state.

effect.description: Wei gains 40 percent movement speed, 40 percent melee damage, and heavy knockback resistance for four seconds. The buff never stacks or extends itself.

codex.shortDescription: Wei chews bamboo to enter a brief enforcer frenzy.
codex.fullDescription: After a stationary wind-up, Wei becomes faster, hits harder, and resists knockback while a persistent aura marks the buff.
codex.counterplay: Punish the stationary wind-up, then kite until the four-second aura collapses.

presentation.vfxDescription: Bamboo splinters, swirling leaves, red-envelope confetti, gold sparks, footstep dust, red afterimages, and a roar pulse with screen shake.

telegraph.description: A 12-foot red faerie circle locks at the player's current position. Crown-point runes form around its edge while the interior fills toward detonation.

effect.description: The circle erupts for moderate damage and applies Tarnished for four seconds: 30 percent lower movement speed and 25 percent lower attack speed. Tarnished does not stack.

codex.shortDescription: Mab detonates a locked circle of corroded glamour.
codex.fullDescription: A crown-marked faerie circle erupts in verdigris magic, damaging victims and temporarily Tarnishing their movement and attack speed.
codex.counterplay: Leave the circle after it locks; it never follows the player during its 1.5-second warning.

presentation.vfxDescription: Verdigris flame, bronze dust, rust flakes, spectral teal butterflies, black-violet mist, crown sparks, a vertical light column, and a shattering ring pulse.

telegraph.description: Twelve long red projectile arrows radiate like clock spokes, showing every fireball path and safe gap. Alternating casts visibly rotate the whole pattern by 15 degrees.

effect.description: Skritt fires twelve straight crown-flame projectiles simultaneously. Casts alternate deterministically between the base pattern and a 15-degree offset.

codex.shortDescription: Skritt launches a rotating twelve-spoke crown barrage.
codex.fullDescription: Twelve crown-flame projectiles burst outward along fully telegraphed spokes, with every other cast rotating the deterministic pattern.
codex.counterplay: Read the visible spoke pattern and step into a safe gap before the simultaneous launch.

presentation.vfxDescription: Crown flame jets, an ember halo, upward sparks, smoke plumes, molten-orange trails, impact cinders, char flakes, and a coronation flash.

telegraph.description: Three 8-foot red circles lock into a triangle around the player's position. Fungal veins crawl inward while every circle fills toward detonation.

effect.description: All three blooms deal impact damage, then persist as toxic spore clouds for four seconds and deal light repeated damage inside their glowing rims.

codex.shortDescription: The Sovereign Cap blooms three persistent spore zones.
codex.fullDescription: Three locked fungal circles erupt together, then linger as clearly rimmed toxic clouds that punish anyone remaining inside.
codex.counterplay: Exit the triangle before detonation and route around the persistent glowing cloud rims.

presentation.vfxDescription: Bioluminescent gill pulses, erupting mushroom sprouts, powder plumes, drifting spores, fungal tendrils, ground fog, and popping puffballs.

telegraph.description: A narrow red arrow-lane expands from Bufo's mouth toward the player's locked position and shows the tongue's exact width, direction, and endpoint.

effect.description: Bufo lashes straight down the lane. A hit deals moderate damage and pulls the player to five feet in front of her; a miss causes a brief recovery.

codex.shortDescription: Bufo lashes a locked tongue lane and reels victims in.
codex.fullDescription: A clearly marked tongue strike deals damage and drags its victim into Big Mama's close-range pressure.
codex.counterplay: Sidestep the narrow locked lane and punish Bufo during her miss recovery.

presentation.vfxDescription: Pulsing throat sac, saliva bubbles, wet tongue streak, elastic trail, swamp spray, mucus strings, impact droplets, drag dust, and a retract snap.

telegraph.description: A red rectangular lane locks toward the player while double-headed arrows show that the gear-saw will travel out and return along the same route.

effect.description: Fizzwick launches a gear-saw to the lane endpoint, holds it there for 0.3 seconds, then returns it along the same path. Both passes deal damage independently.

codex.shortDescription: Fizzwick sends a gear-saw out and back through one lane.
codex.fullDescription: The same visible lane is dangerous twice as a giant clockwork saw tears outward, pauses, and rips back to its owner.
codex.counterplay: Leave the lane after it locks and stay clear until the visibly returning saw is caught.

presentation.vfxDescription: Brass fragments, spark showers, oily smoke, piston steam, orange saw trails, loose screws, floor scrapes, and a violent re-catch burst.

telegraph.description: Three red sewer-sigil circles lock around Squick, each filling toward a clearly timed minion arrival.

effect.description: Squick summons three plague rats into the marked circles, but no more than six minions created by this ability may be alive at once.

codex.shortDescription: Squick calls plague rats through marked sewer sigils.
codex.fullDescription: Three clearly marked summon circles disgorge plague rats until Squick reaches the ability's owned-minion cap.
codex.counterplay: Use the warning to reposition away from the circles, then clear owned minions before the next call.

presentation.vfxDescription: Sewer-green sigils, rattling grates, diseased mist, clawed silhouettes, trash bursts, rat trails, and a shower of filthy guild tokens.

telegraph.description: A red thorn annulus forms around Abuela with exact inner and outer rims, leaving visibly safe regions close to her and beyond the ring.

effect.description: A dense ring of thorns erupts through the marked annulus, dealing moderate damage and strong outward knockback.

codex.shortDescription: Abuela erupts a thorn ring with two safe regions.
codex.fullDescription: A precisely marked annulus explodes into thorns while the space beside Abuela and the area beyond the outer rim remain safe.
codex.counterplay: Commit either inside the inner rim or outside the outer rim before the thorn ring erupts.

presentation.vfxDescription: Cracking earth, erupting needles, flower petals, pollen clouds, sap droplets, tumbling cactus pads, and a rippling dust ring.

telegraph.description: Three concentric red bands lock around Vesper and illuminate in the exact inner-to-outer order in which they will detonate.

effect.description: Three sonic annuli detonate from inner to outer at fixed 0.35-second intervals, each dealing moderate damage and knockback.

codex.shortDescription: Vesper detonates three sonic rings from inside out.
codex.fullDescription: Three concentric warning bands burst in a fixed inner-to-outer sequence, turning each already-detonated band into temporary safe ground.
codex.counterplay: Cross behind each detonation as it passes instead of trying to outrun all three rings.

presentation.vfxDescription: Violet waveform rings, shattered musical glyphs, bat silhouettes, moonlit dust, fluttering cape motes, floor ripples, and bass-heavy screen shake.

telegraph.description: Molt clamps down while a thick tide-blue shell aura closes around him, with a visible fill showing exactly when the defensive state begins.

effect.description: Molt gains 70 percent damage reduction and complete knockback immunity for 3.5 seconds. The state does not stack or extend itself.

codex.shortDescription: Molt visibly locks down behind a fortified shell.
codex.fullDescription: A closing shell aura announces a short defensive state that sharply reduces damage and prevents knockback.
codex.counterplay: Use the warning to stop committing cooldowns, reposition, and resume pressure when the shell aura breaks.

presentation.vfxDescription: Interlocking shell plates, seawater jets, foam, coin-like barnacles, blue shield ripples, salt crystals, and a dramatic shell-break burst.

telegraph.description: A 100-degree red melee arc locks beside the Broodfather while a rotating arrow shows the complete 360-degree sweep and its deterministic direction.

effect.description: The Broodfather rotates the damaging melee arc through one full revolution over 1.6 seconds. Sweep direction alternates deterministically each cast.

codex.shortDescription: The Broodfather rotates a wide melee arc around himself.
codex.fullDescription: A red arc and rotation arrow reveal a full chitinous sweep whose direction alternates predictably on every cast.
codex.counterplay: Move around the Broodfather in the opposite direction of the visible rotation arrow or retreat beyond the arc.

presentation.vfxDescription: Chitin shards, wing-case flashes, amber streaks, mandible sparks, floor gouges, dust vortices, beetle silhouettes, and a full-ring impact ripple.

entries.announcementText: Foreman Grubbs is coming up under you!

telegraph.description: A cracked red lane locks from Grubbs to the player's position and ends in an expanding red eruption circle, showing the full burrow route and impact area.

effect.description: Grubbs burrows along the locked lane and erupts at its endpoint for moderate damage and strong outward knockback.

codex.shortDescription: Grubbs burrows down a marked lane and erupts at its end.
codex.fullDescription: A cracked-earth lane and endpoint circle expose the exact underground route before the Foreman erupts in a violent blast.
codex.counterplay: Step off the lane and clear the endpoint circle; Grubbs cannot retarget once underground.

presentation.vfxDescription: Rolling earth ridges, flying rocks, warning lamps, drill sparks, dirt fountains, broken signboards, dust columns, and a crater shockwave.

telegraph.description: A broad red dash lane locks toward the player, with coin-shaped chevrons and a bag-marked endpoint showing Rocco's exact route.

effect.description: Rocco dashes through the lane for moderate damage. A hit steals up to 10 gold, but the exact stolen amount is dropped recoverably at the dash endpoint.

codex.shortDescription: Rocco dashes through a lane and temporarily steals gold.
codex.fullDescription: A coin-marked lane announces Rocco's robbery dash; any stolen gold remains recoverable where the dash ends.
codex.counterplay: Sidestep the locked route, or collect the dropped gold at the endpoint if Rocco connects.

presentation.vfxDescription: Coin sprays, receipt ribbons, trash-can lid sparks, bag silhouettes, speed streaks, bottle-cap confetti, skid dust, and a jackpot burst.

telegraph.description: A broad 120-degree red cone locks in front of Honkrado while expanding sound-wave chevrons show the exact reach of the coming honk.

effect.description: Honkrado unleashes a sonic blast for moderate damage and strong knockback, then applies Rattled for three seconds: 20 percent lower outgoing damage.

codex.shortDescription: Honkrado blasts a wide cone that leaves victims Rattled.
codex.fullDescription: A massive telegraphed honk knocks victims away and briefly reduces the damage they deal.
codex.counterplay: Move behind the Don or beyond the cone after its direction locks.

presentation.vfxDescription: Stacked sound rings, feather cyclones, shattered omerta seals, brass flashes, floor ripples, airborne dust, and a comically oversized HONK shockwave.

telegraph.description: A full-arena red line locks through the player's position while ember arrows and a filling heat strip reveal the exact persistent fire-wall footprint.

effect.description: The line erupts for impact damage and remains as a damaging hellfire wall for four seconds without moving or tracking.

codex.shortDescription: Scorch lays a persistent hellfire wall across the arena.
codex.fullDescription: A locked full-arena warning line erupts and remains aflame, splitting the battlefield for several seconds.
codex.counterplay: Cross the warning line before ignition or route around the persistent wall after it forms.

presentation.vfxDescription: Coal sparks, molten cracks, black smoke columns, licking flame sheets, flying cinders, scorched timecards, heat distortion, and repeated ember bursts.

telegraph.description: A wide red slime annulus appears at 24 feet with inward arrows showing that the damaging ring will contract to five feet around its locked center.

effect.description: A four-foot-wide damaging slime ring contracts from 24 feet to five feet over 2.5 seconds. Contact deals moderate damage and applies a 35 percent slow for four seconds.

codex.shortDescription: The Godfather closes a damaging slime ring around the arena.
codex.fullDescription: A visibly contracting annulus squeezes inward over time, damaging and slowing anyone touched by its moving rim.
codex.counterplay: Read the inward arrows, cross the rim once on your terms, and avoid being pinched against terrain.

presentation.vfxDescription: Glittering slime wakes, shell spirals, bubble curtains, oily rainbow highlights, splashing contract stamps, floor ripples, and a closing spiral burst.
